ResaleFeePolicy.description:
**What a resale costs and how high it may be priced.** The listing snapshots these onto itself at creation; this is where they come from.
**A rule and its snapshot are two rows on purpose.** `payments.fee_rule` and `orders.order_fee` already work this way — changing a commission must not restate what somebody already sold at.

eventId.description: **The narrowest match wins.** Null is the venue default; a policy naming an event overrides it for that event, because a final and a Tuesday fixture do not resell on the same terms.

buyerFeePercent.description: Added to what the buyer pays.

priceCapPercent.description:
**A ceiling as a percentage of face value.** Null means uncapped, which stays a venue decision rather than a default — the wording `ResaleListing.priceCapPercent` already uses, kept identical so the snapshot and its source cannot drift apart in meaning.
**Anti-scalping limits are regulated in several jurisdictions**; whether they bind in the UAE and Oman is recorded as a research item on the resale backlog entry and is not settled here.

feesShownToSeller.description: **Whether the seller sees the deduction before listing.** A seller who learns the commission at payout is a complaint, and `ListingCreationSellerConfiguration` already draws an `estimatedProceeds` that needs this to be true to mean anything.

scopePath.description: **The partition key** (ADR-0005). Operations write it at `venue` scope.

ResaleMarketplaceConfig.description:
**How a venue's resale marketplace runs: terms, pricing mode and guardrails, moderation, listing lifecycle, buyer checkout hold, seller settlement timing, and the white-label deployment** (DM5, 29 September: data model for the agreed operations; MoM 1 Sep 4.14: admin-configured resale price range; own B2C site, hosted white-label portal, or API).
**One row per venue.** The resale model is four tables and they do not overlap: what a resale costs is `orders.resale_fee_policy` (narrowable by event and product), which tickets may be resold is `orders.resale_eligibility_rule` (narrowable the same way), how the marketplace behaves is this row, and what each seller is owed is `orders.resale_settlement`. The listing snapshots what it needs at creation.
**Written by `setResaleMarketplaceConfig` and read by `getResaleMarketplaceConfig`** (decided 29 September, writers pass).

maximumDiscountPercent.description: The floor below face value, beside `ResaleFeePolicy.priceCapPercent` above it.

moderationMode.description: `reviewTriggers` sends a listing to `pendingReview` when `moderationMode` is `riskBased`; `manual` reviews every listing.

checkoutHoldMinutes.description: How long a listing stays `reserved` for one buyer in checkout.

settlementTiming.description: **Default `afterAccessValidation`**: the seller is paid after the buyer is admitted, not after they pay (`ResaleListing.payoutStatus`).

termsVersion.description: The version a seller accepts at listing.

branding.description: Logo, colours, typography, support contact and legal links for the marketplace pages. **A hosted white-label marketplace takes the venue's white-label theme when this is null**, so a venue sets it only to differ.

scopePath.description: **The partition key** (ADR-0005). Operations write it at `venue` scope.
